subject.title: Feature: Auto-leave WhatsApp groups not in allowlist + group-join webhook

question: Should WhatsApp gain an opt-in deterministic unknown-group policy, and if so should its admission boundary be the effective groups map with a minimized owner notification and optional automatic leave?
rationale: The transport appears capable, but source inspection cannot choose when destructive departure is appropriate, which identifiers may enter an agent session, or whether a generic message-tool action should expose account membership changes.

options.title: Add deterministic plugin policy
options.body: Add optional ignore, notify, and leave behavior in the WhatsApp plugin using effective group-JID admission, with redacted owner-only events and an authorization-gated leave action.

options.title: Ship notification first
options.body: Add a minimized owner notification for newly observed groups while retaining manual departure until live event-ordering and authorization behavior is proven.

options.title: Retain deny-only behavior
options.body: Keep dropping unauthorized traffic and require operators to manage group membership through WhatsApp itself.

recommendation.title: Add deterministic plugin policy
recommendation.body: Add optional ignore, notify, and leave behavior in the WhatsApp plugin using effective group-JID admission, with redacted owner-only events and an authorization-gated leave action.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent adjacent WhatsApp policy/docs history and already articulated the unresolved product boundary in the issue discussion.
